learning_outcomes.text: Assess the application possibilities of computers and microcontrollers.
Describe communication and corresponding protocols in client-server systems or computer networks.
Use spreadsheet systems for data preparation and data analysis.
Understand, describe, and independently develop simple programs in the Python programming language to solve technical-scientific problems.
Describe the purpose and structure of selection statements, loop constructions, fundamental data structures, and functions, and apply corresponding programming concepts to problems.
Apply classes and elementary object-oriented concepts to solve problems.
Know the Raspberry Pi Pico as a microcontroller platform and be able to access connected hardware (e.g., sensors) via Python programs.
Become familiar with new subject areas.

syllabus_topics: Structure of computer networks and client-server systems (IP addresses, basic services, protocols)
Spreadsheet systems: use of references, formulas, and functions
Use of the Pi Pico microcontroller
Students can grasp the functionality of software tools.
Students are able to break down complex problems into sub-problems.
Students are able to abstract and systematically work on tasks.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam. Successful participation in the practicum is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
